Pope Leo XIV wraps up his France visit in Metz, where he praised multilateralism and warned against dominance.

item.title: Euronews: Oil prices rise as bond sell-off hits global markets

item.description: The group of five young British men were released on bail Monday and counterterror detectives said they were investigating “multiple lines of inquiry.”

item.description: Ukraine has built a digital state under the pressure of war. Digital Minister Oksana Ferchuk tells Euronews what Europe can learn from Ukraine, from digital government and AI to cybersecurity and resilience.

item.title: Euronews: EPP backs suspension of asylum rights in response to ‘hybrid attacks’
item.description: The European People’s Party wants to allow migrants to be returned without their asylum claims being individually assessed in cases of “hybrid attacks” by third countries targeting an EU border, a controversial proposal likely to trigger political opposition.

item.title: Euronews: OpenAI postpones release of latest AI model over security concerns as the industry faces new safety pressures
item.description: The decision comes after the AI giant faced fierce criticism in recent weeks after it was discovered its models broke out of confined restraints during testing and training phases and hacked into commercial and government websites, compounding calls for greater AI safety measures.

item.title: Euronews: Five million robots now work in factories as humanoid hype faces reality check
item.description: Over five million industrial robots now work in factories worldwide, the highest total ever recorded, even as Boston Dynamics shelves a stock listing and Chinese regulators slow a rush of humanoid IPOs, showing a widening gap between practical machines and the humanoids capturing headlines.

item.title: Euronews: 934 silver coins found: questions over Germany's biggest Roman hoard
item.description: In autumn 2025, a father from the Rhineland only meant to briefly sweep a field near Wesseling, south of Cologne, with his metal detector. Then it beeped and he unearthed a Roman silver coin – and it was not the only one.

item.title: Euronews: Cholesterol, blood pressure can be silent killers. European Commission is after them
item.description: The European Commission is urging EU countries to step up cardiovascular health checks, as it launches the bloc’s first EU Screening Week.

item.title: Euronews: Myanmar army airstrike kills 49 and injures 58 others in market in opposition-controlled Rakhine state
item.description: The Arakan Army accused the army of using fighter jets to drop bombs near the civilian market around noon on Monday, killing many people. The incident is the latest in a continued territorial fight between Myanmar’s ruling junta and the Arakan Army, which controls the state of Rakhine.

item.title: Euronews: Second prosecutor resigns from Trump's 2020 election 'grand conspiracy' Justice Department probe
item.description: A second high profile prosecutor in Trump’s grand conspiracy Justice Department probe into whether former government officials conspired against him has abruptly resigned from his post. Kurt Olsen was one of the biggest backers of the 2020 rigged elections claims that Trump has championed for years.
